title: Capability-aware native Ollama tool-call diagnostic
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';if(-not(Test-Path $ep)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_MISSING'};$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 10;$models=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{$_.name});if($models.Count -eq 0){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_MODELS'};$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$results=@();foreach($m in $models){$caps=@();try{$showBody=@{model=$m}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5;$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $showBody -TimeoutSec 30;$caps=@($show.capabilities)}catch{$results+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;capabilities='SHOW_ERROR';nativeToolCalls=-1;status='SHOW_ERROR';content=$_.Exception.Message};Write-Output ('MODEL='+$m+' STATUS=SHOW_ERROR');continue};if($caps -notcontains 'tools'){$results+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;capabilities=($caps -join ',');nativeToolCalls=0;status='UNSUPPORTED';content=''};Write-Output ('MODEL='+$m+' CAPS='+($caps -join ',')+' STATUS=UNSUPPORTED');continue};$chatBody=@{model=$m;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='user';content='Call the write_probe tool with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/native-tool-probe.txt and content NATIVE_TOOL_OK. Do not answer normally; call the tool.'});tools=@($tool)}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20;try{$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $chatBody -TimeoutSec 180;$msg=$resp.message;$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};$txt='';if($null -ne $msg -and ($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'content')){$txt=[string]$msg.content};$status=if($tc.Count -gt 0){'PASS'}else{'NO_TOOL_CALL'};$results+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;capabilities=($caps -join ',');nativeToolCalls=$tc.Count;status=$status;content=$txt};Write-Output ('MODEL='+$m+' CAPS='+($caps -join ',')+' STATUS='+$status+' NATIVE_TOOL_CALLS='+$tc.Count);if($tc.Count -gt 0){Write-Output ('TOOLCALL_JSON='+(($tc|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress)))}elseif($txt){Write-Output ('CONTENT='+($txt -replace '[
]+',' '))}}catch{$results+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;capabilities=($caps -join ',');nativeToolCalls=-1;status='CHAT_ERROR';content=$_.Exception.Message};Write-Output ('MODEL='+$m+' CAPS='+($caps -join ',')+' STATUS=CHAT_ERROR')}};$results|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content (Join-Path $root '057h-native-ollama-tool-evidence.json') -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output 'V437_057H_DIAG=PASS'
